entities.summary: Alberto Ullastres was Spain's trade minister (1957–1965) and ambassador to the European Economic Community (1965–1976) under Francisco Franco. Ullastres was part of the so-called "Opusdeistas" – ministers under Franco who were also members of the Opus Dei organisation.
